contexts.japanese: 俺の心を掻き乱すような真似は、慎んでくれ」

MG.translation: "...I appreciate the sentiment. ...I'm in the middle of a vital game right now. This is the final game, ...and it's vital both for me... and Beato as well. So please. Don't mess with my heart any more than is necessary."

findings.sourceReading: 俺の心を掻き乱すような真似は慎んでくれ asks them to refrain from actions that disturb or churn up his heart.
findings.alternative: Trouble me may include emotional distress, but any more than is necessary introduces a tolerable-necessity qualification absent from the request and loses the explicit inner turmoil.
